thread:
Zoe: Hey — spinning up the quickstart sample (JS SDK) and my first call returned 402, but the dashboard shows a card attached. weird part: after a few automatic SDK retries it eventually succeeded and produced two billed responses. anyone seen double-billing on a flaky 402->200 retry? :worried:

Marco: can you share the SDK version and the code you used (redact keys)? some older SDKs retried on network-like errors and didn't treat 4xx as terminal.

Zoe: using @redwood/js 0.9.1. code: ```const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });\nconst res = await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-small', messages: [{role:'user', content:'hi'}] });``` runs in a serverless function. logs: first response 402 JSON, then SDK retried and got 200. billing shows two token usages.

Elaine: serverless cold start + occasional permission propagation can cause a first-call 402 if the workspace/card was just added. but SDK should not retry 4xx by default. 0.9.1 had a bug where network errors and transient 4xx from billing cache were wrapped as retriable.

Marco: confirmed — we shipped a retry-layer change in 0.9.x that treats any non-2xx with no explicit non-retriable flag as retriable. that was to help transient infra errors but it's too broad. recommend patching SDK to mark 4xx (401/402/403/404) as non-retriable unless header x-retryable exists.

Zoe: interesting. is there a safe mitigation on the backend to avoid double-billing when the SDK retries?

billing-ops: we can add idempotency hints for chat generation (Idempotency-Key header) but for streaming token-based billing it's tricky. best approach: SDK should avoid retrying on payment/auth 4xx. we can also add a short-lived 'billing-propagation' grace window for workspace updates so immediate first calls after adding a card don't 402. tradeoff: that may mask genuine invalid cards.

infra-bot: deploy rwd-sdk-js@0.9.2 will include fix to retry policy. rollout plan: canary to 10% in an hour, full roll in 6 hours.

Zoe: ok thanks — for now i downgraded to 0.9.0 and the sample returned 200 on first try (no duplicate billing). i'll open a quick PR in the sample-app to pin the dependency until 0.9.2 lands.

Marco: creating ticket DX-1419: "JS SDK: do not retry on 4xx auth/billing errors; surface billing_hint in error response". runbook: include recommended idempotency header pattern and sample serverless snippet.

devex-bot: DX-1419 created. Suggested SDK change: treat 401/402/403/404 as terminal; include error.metadata.billing_hint and error.metadata.workspace_hint where safe. Link: https://internal.docs/redwood/devex/sdk-retry-guidelines

Elaine: small UX follow-up: quickstart UI shows a persistent billing toast which made Zoe think billing was blocking. can we change toast to 'advisory' with a lightweight CTA to test workspace/key mapping?

billing-ops: agree. i'll take DX-1419 subtask to add a masked workspace hint in 402 bodies (short-hash) and a CTA URL to 'manage billing'. will coordinate with privacy.

Zoe: resolved for me now. leaving the pinned dep PR and will verify once 0.9.2 canary is live. thanks all :sparkles:
